# Tide-table importer for the harbour almanac

The harbour authority publishes a tide almanac once a day. Harborlight reads it
as-is and folds each entry into a canonical tide window, so every downstream
view answers from one table rather than re-parsing the almanac.

## Goals

- Treat the almanac as read-only input; never write back to it.
- Make re-imports idempotent — the same almanac twice yields one set of windows.
